    The opposite ray system #

    The paper proves many statements together with "the dual assertion", obtained "by passing to the opposite algebra". Tab.op reverses rays and products; its linearization is the opposite algebra of kP (linOpEquiv), so it is representation-finite when kP is (isRepresentationFinite_op); Sys.op carries Setting 8.4 over.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
